## Details

<a id="fighter_piece0_tail"></a>
### [`fighter_piece0_tail`](../../../../src/graphics/fighter_pieces.asm#L6) `$0838-$083F`

*data*

Last 8 bytes of the slot of piece 0. Piece number 0 means no piece, so nothing reads this slot.

<a id="fighter_pieces"></a>
### [`fighter_pieces`](../../../../src/graphics/fighter_pieces.asm#L9) `$0840-$43FF`

*data*

Fighter body pieces 1-$ef: 64 bytes each, at $0800 + 64 * piece number. Each piece has the sprite format: 21 rows of 3 bytes, multicolour. The 64th byte is not used. A frame record ($bdbb) gives 9 piece numbers for a grid of 3 x 3 pieces. $8a46 copies the non-zero bytes of each piece into the composition buffer at $05ca.
